versions.changelog:
- Initial release of cn-hex-decoder: a Hex encoding/decoding tool.
- Supports text-to-hex and hex-to-text conversion.
- Provides color code (e.g., #RRGGBB) parsing functionality.
- Enables batch processing for multiple lines of text.
- Offers formatted hex output with options like spacing and 0x prefix.
- Pure Python, no external dependencies required.
